name: Polar decomposition of multivariate regular variation
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.isRegVarVector_iff.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
  [SecondCountableTopology E] {X : Ω → E} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α) (hX : Measurable X) :
  (∃ μ, ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegVarVector P X α μ) ↔
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (fun x => P.real {ω | x < ‖X ω‖}) (-α) ∧
      ∃ S,
        MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure S ∧
          ExtremeValueTheory.TendstoLawCond P (fun x => {ω | x < ‖X ω‖}) (fun x ω => ‖X ω‖⁻¹ • X ω)
            Filter.atTop S
scope_note: Normalized by P(||X|| > x) rather than by a sequence a_n, which changes the exponent measure only by a scale.

name: The exponent measure in polar coordinates
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegVarVector.eq_polarMeasure.{u_1, u_2} {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E]
  [SecondCountableTopology E] {X : Ω → E} {α : ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} (hα : 0 < α)
  (h : ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegVarVector P X α μ) (hX : Measurable X) :
  μ = ExtremeValueTheory.polarMeasure α (ExtremeValueTheory.spectralMeasure μ)

name: Independent components: asymptotic independence
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.isRegVarVector_of_indepFun.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P] {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 < α)
  {X₁ X₂ : Ω → ℝ} (h₁ : Measurable X₁) (h₂ : Measurable X₂) (h₁0 : ∀ (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ X₁ ω)
  (h₂0 : ∀ (ω : Ω), 0 ≤ X₂ ω) (hind : ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun X₁ X₂ P)
  (hRV : ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegularlyVarying (fun x => P.real {ω | x < X₁ ω}) (-α)) {c : ℝ}
  (hc : 0 ≤ c)
  (hbal :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun x => P.real {ω | x < X₂ ω} / P.real {ω | x < X₁ ω}) Filter.atTop (nhds c)) :
  ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegVarVector P (fun ω => (X₁ ω, X₂ ω)) α
    (ExtremeValueTheory.polarMeasure α (ExtremeValueTheory.axesSpectralMeasure c))
scope_note: Two nonnegative components (pointwise) with a tail ratio limit; no general dimension or sign.

name: Converse Cramér-Wold device for non-integer index
scope_note: Finite-dimensional, normalization by a regularly varying V, non-integer alpha as in the source. The integer-alpha counterexamples of Hult-Lindskog are not formalized.

name: Characterization of multivariate domains of attraction
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.isMDAWith_iff.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι]
  {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (ι → ℝ)} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {a b : ℕ → ι → ℝ}
  (hcμ : ∀ (i : ι), Continuous ↑(ExtremeValueTheory.marginal μ i).toStieltjesFunction)
  (hcν : ∀ (i : ι), Continuous ↑(ExtremeValueTheory.marginal ν i).toStieltjesFunction)
  (ha : ∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ι), 0 < a n i) :
  ExtremeValueTheory.IsMDAWith μ ν a b ↔
    (∀ (i : ι) (t : ℝ),
        Filter.Tendsto
          (fun n => ↑(ExtremeValueTheory.marginal μ i).toStieltjesFunction (a n i * t + b n i) ^ n)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (↑(ExtremeValueTheory.marginal ν i).toStieltjesFunction t))) ∧
      ∀ (y : ι → ℝ),
        (∀ (i : ι), 0 < y i) →
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun n =>
              ↑n *
                (1 -
                  μ.real
                    (Set.Iic fun i => (ExtremeValueTheory.marginal μ i).tailQuantile (↑n * y i))))
            Filter.atTop
            (nhds
              (ExtremeValueTheory.maxStableExponent (ExtremeValueTheory.frechetStandardization ν)
                y))
scope_note: Continuous marginals of both laws are assumed, an extra hypothesis.

name: The multivariate GPD as a limit of conditional excess laws
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.IsMDAWith.tendsto_conditionalExcessCDF.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι]
  {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (ι → ℝ)} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {a b : ℕ → ι → ℝ}
  (h : ExtremeValueTheory.IsMDAWith μ ν a b)
  (hc : ∀ (i : ι), Continuous ↑(ExtremeValueTheory.marginal ν i).toStieltjesFunction) {x : ι → ℝ}
  (hx : 0 < ν.real (Set.Iic (x ⊓ 0))) (h0 : ν.real (Set.Iic 0) < 1) :
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ExtremeValueTheory.conditionalExcessCDF μ (a n) (b n) x) Filter.atTop
    (nhds (ExtremeValueTheory.mgpdCDF ν x))
scope_note: Needs G(x ^ 0) > 0, which rules out unit-Fréchet-standardized limits; pointwise in x, with thresholds along the normalizing sequence b_n.

name: The standardized multivariate GPD as a limit
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.IsMDAWith.tendsto_conditionalExcess_tailQuantile.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι]
  {μ ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (ι → ℝ)} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ]
  [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν] {a b : ℕ → ι → ℝ} [Nonempty ι]
  (h : ExtremeValueTheory.IsMDAWith μ ν a b)
  (hc : ∀ (i : ι), Continuous ↑(ExtremeValueTheory.marginal ν i).toStieltjesFunction) {y : ι → ℝ}
  (hy : ∀ (i : ι), 0 < y i) :
  Filter.Tendsto
    (fun n =>
      μ.real
          ((Set.Iic fun i => (ExtremeValueTheory.marginal μ i).tailQuantile (↑n * y i)) \
            Set.Iic fun i => (ExtremeValueTheory.marginal μ i).tailQuantile (↑n * 1)) /
        μ.real (Set.Iic fun i => (ExtremeValueTheory.marginal μ i).tailQuantile (↑n * 1))ᶜ)
    Filter.atTop
    (nhds (ExtremeValueTheory.standardMGPD (ExtremeValueTheory.frechetStandardization ν) y))
scope_note: Unit Fréchet scale only, at thresholds U(n 1) and pointwise in y.

name: A spectral measure gives a simple max-stable law
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.exists_isSimpleMaxStable_of_spectralMeasure.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι]
  (H : MeasureTheory.Measure (ι → ENNReal)) [MeasureTheory.SFinite H]
  (hH : ∀ (i : ι), ∫⁻ (w : ι → ENNReal), w i ∂H = 1) :
  ∃ ν,
    ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable ν ∧
      ∀ (y : ι → ℝ),
        (∀ (i : ι), 0 < y i) →
          ν (Set.Iic y) =
            ENNReal.ofReal
              (Real.exp (-(∫⁻ (w : ι → ENNReal), ⨆ i, w i / ENNReal.ofReal (y i) ∂H).toReal))
scope_note: The constructive direction, as named; s-finite H on [0, infinity]^iota, normalized.

name: Spectral representation of simple max-stable laws
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable.exists_hasSpectralMeasure.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι]
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (ι → ℝ)} (h : ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable μ) :
  ∃ H,
    MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure H ∧
      (∀ᵐ (w : ι → ENNReal) ∂H, ∀ (i : ι), w i ≤ 1) ∧
        (∀ᵐ (w : ι → ENNReal) ∂H, ⨆ i, w i = 1) ∧
          (∀ (i : ι), ∫⁻ (w : ι → ENNReal), w i ∂H = 1) ∧ ExtremeValueTheory.HasSpectralMeasure μ H
scope_note: Any finite dimension; H on the sup-norm sphere. Simple (unit Fréchet margins) only, as named.

name: The spectral measure is unique
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable.existsUnique_hasSpectralMeasure.{u_1} {ι : Type u_1}
  [Fintype ι] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (ι → ℝ)} (h : ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable μ) :
  ∃! H,
    MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure H ∧
      (∀ᵐ (w : ι → ENNReal) ∂H, ⨆ i, w i = 1) ∧ ExtremeValueTheory.HasSpectralMeasure μ H

name: Simple max-stable vectors are regularly varying
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable.isRegVarVector.{u_1, u_2} {ι : Type u_1} [Fintype ι]
  {H : MeasureTheory.Measure (ι → ENNReal)} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure H] {Ω : Type u_2}
  {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  {X : Ω → ι → ℝ} (hX : Measurable X)
  (hS : ExtremeValueTheory.HasSpectralMeasure (MeasureTheory.Measure.map X P) H)
  (h : ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable (MeasureTheory.Measure.map X P))
  (hH : ∀ᵐ (w : ι → ENNReal) ∂H, ⨆ i, w i = 1) [Nonempty ι] :
  ExtremeValueTheory.IsRegVarVector P X 1 (ExtremeValueTheory.maxStableTailMeasure H)
scope_note: Index 1, as for unit Fréchet margins.

name: Tail dependence of max-stable laws: lambda_U = 2 - theta
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable.hasUpperTailDependence {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)}
  (h : ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable μ) :
  ExtremeValueTheory.HasUpperTailDependence μ (fun z => z 0) (fun z => z 1)
    (2 - ExtremeValueTheory.extremalCoefficient μ)

name: Convexity of the Pickands dependence function
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable.convexOn_pickandsDependence
  {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)} (h : ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable ν) :
  ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Icc 0 1) (ExtremeValueTheory.pickandsDependence ν)
scope_note: Every bivariate simple max-stable law. Convention A(t) with the weight t on coordinate 0, mirrored against some texts.

name: Strong consistency of Pickands' dependence estimator
statement:
ExtremeValueTheory.tendsto_pickandsDependenceEstimator.{u_1} {Ω : Type u_1} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
  {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {Z : ℕ → Ω → Fin 2 → ℝ} (hZ : Measurable (Z 0))
  (hindep : Pairwise fun i j => ProbabilityTheory.IndepFun (Z i) (Z j) P)
  (hident : ∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (Z i) (Z 0) P P)
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)} (hlaw : MeasureTheory.Measure.map (Z 0) P = μ)
  (h : ExtremeValueTheory.IsSimpleMaxStable μ) {t : ℝ} (ht : t ∈ Set.Ioo 0 1) :
  ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂P,
    Filter.Tendsto (ExtremeValueTheory.pickandsDependenceEstimator t fun i => Z i ω) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (ExtremeValueTheory.pickandsDependence μ t))
scope_note: Known unit Fréchet margins and an exactly max-stable sample, as in Pickands' setting; only pairwise independence is used. Estimated margins and data only in the domain of attraction are not covered.
